wholePhysicalScope: Named 14-point native perimeter covering the linked museum wings.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the low entry gables, taller corrugated hall and curved entrance canopy. Near levels resolve glazing, roof edges, ribbing and canopy bracing.
limitations: The museum represents July 2017. The visible low gables and tall corrugated hall follow the exact Qualla photo, and the mapped perimeter constrains the whole building. Roof sections and obscured elevations are estimated.
The original terrain field is preserved. Entrance and riverside paving, window counts and service openings are approximate. Detached boats, flags and landscaping are outside the structure scope.
